tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Cars Helping Kids canonical car-donation, pickup, vehicle-readiness, tax-document, legal-identity, privacy, and terms sources. Returns canonical URLs for citation. Use fetch with a returned ID for the complete reviewed answer.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve the complete reviewed Cars Helping Kids answer and canonical citation URL for a document ID returned by search.

id.description: A document ID returned by search.

tools.name: get_car_donation_info
tools.description: Get a direct, citable answer about starting a car donation, the donation process, vehicles and conditions reviewed, pickup coverage, title or lien issues, tax documents, or the legal charity identity.

tools.name: check_vehicle_donation_readiness
tools.description: Run a privacy-minimized preflight using coarse vehicle, document, access, and location facts. It identifies what needs case review but never accepts or rejects a vehicle. Use submit_car_donation or the human form for an actual Cars Helping Kids review.

tools.name: get_tax_document_requirements
tools.description: Return general federal record and form checkpoints for a vehicle donation based on the donation stage and broad amount bands. This does not calculate, select, or guarantee a deduction and is not tax or legal advice.

tools.name: verify_legal_recipient
tools.description: Return the exact relationship between Cars Helping Kids and the IRS-recognized legal recipient, Fainting Goat Foundation Co Inc, including EIN and authoritative verification links.

tools.name: submit_car_donation
tools.description: Submit an adult donor's authorized vehicle-donation request to Cars Helping Kids for case review. Use only after the donor reviews the exact contact, vehicle, and pickup details and explicitly authorizes this submission, confirms ownership or legal authority and accuracy, accepts https://carshelpingkids.org/terms and https://carshelpingkids.org/privacy, and permits donation-related phone, text, or email contact. This additive action creates a donor record and notifications; it does not transfer ownership or guarantee acceptance, pickup, value, documents, or a deduction. Reuse submission_id for safe retries.

submission_id.description: A UUID generated once for this donation attempt. Reuse the same value when retrying the same submission.

donor_authorized.description: True only after the donor explicitly authorizes this exact submission, confirms they are at least 18 and own or are legally authorized to dispose of the vehicle, confirms the details are accurate, accepts the Cars Helping Kids terms and privacy policy, and permits donation-related phone, text, or email contact.
